title: NEW: Yuno Quests (On Screen Gameplay)
description: We are thrilled to announce the release of our learning experiences. Each quest (e.g., Da Vinci) is divided into 4-12 contextually relevant learning blocks, allowing users to progress at their own pace. Each block takes about one minute to complete, teaches a handful of essential facts, and immediately follows with a quiz to maximize knowledge retention. At launch, we will publish around 60 quests per language (EN & DE), covering a wide range of subjects—History, Economics, Politics, Art, Science, and more. This results in roughly 30,000 new interactive questions to engage and challenge our users. In addition, we are upgrading the overall app experience with richer animations & improved gameplay haptics. Our app stands out by combining storytelling, breadth. With rich animations, haptics, and game-like progression, we make learning fun, accessible, and irresistible for everyone.
